import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R

# Get poses of nut center, handle grasp, and target peg block
nut_center_pos, nut_center_quat = get_object_pose("white hollow center of the brown square nut")
grasp_pos, grasp_quat = sample_grasp_pose("extruded handle of the brown square nut")
peg_pos, peg_quat = get_object_pose("brown square block")

# Fixed rigid transform from handle grasp frame to nut center (in grasp frame coordinates)
R_grasp = R.from_quat([grasp_quat[1], grasp_quat[2], grasp_quat[3], grasp_quat[0]])
offset_grasp_frame = R_grasp.inv().apply(nut_center_pos - grasp_pos)

# Grasp the nut by its handle
open_gripper()
goto_pose(grasp_pos, grasp_quat, z_approach=0.1)
close_gripper()

# Lift the nut
lift_pos = grasp_pos.copy()
lift_pos[2] += 0.15
goto_pose(lift_pos, grasp_quat)

# Compute gripper pose so that the nut center aligns above the peg (keep grasp orientation)
target_center = peg_pos.copy()
target_center[2] = peg_pos[2] + 0.02  # slightly above block base so nut slides onto peg
ee_target_pos = target_center - R_grasp.apply(offset_grasp_frame)

# Move above the peg, then insert with approach from above
goto_pose(ee_target_pos, grasp_quat, z_approach=0.12)

# Release the nut and retreat
open_gripper()
retreat_pos = ee_target_pos.copy()
retreat_pos[2] += 0.12
goto_pose(retreat_pos, grasp_quat)
goto_home_joint_position()
